semanticMotion: The poster starts static for two seconds. Then, a subtle controlled light travels slowly across the existing artist names from left to right, highlighting each name in turn with a soft glow. At the same time, the title 'Formen der Abweichung' begins to subtly grow from the existing roots printed beneath it, the roots gently extending and thickening until the full title is exactly formed in its printed placement by the fourth second. From the fifth second, the eyes of the Garten-Golum subtly glow with a faint eerie light, and the eyes blink once at the sixth second, before the poster holds still again.
